topic: How can satellite link budgets be optimized for high throughput and low latency in global aeronautical coverage?
consensus_response: Satellite link budgets can be optimized by combining adaptive modulation, beamforming, and traffic management to balance throughput and latency. Introducing orbital diversity and hybrid constellations further reduces latency, while advanced coding schemes enhance spectral efficiency. These strategies interact to minimize congestion, queuing delays, and signal degradation.
reference_context: Satellite links face challenges from high fixed latency, free-space path loss, and congestion, impacting throughput and QoS.
